_comment: Expected progression rules for the deterministic loop, expressed as machine-
checkable pre/post conditions. The harness drives the loop with a simulated
learner and asserts these after every turn.
The single decision variable is `target_signature_met`, returned by
backend/scoring_service.score_response. The assigned SOLO level is recorded for
research but does not gate progression; the transition's target_signature does.
Rules are ordered by priority: the first matching rule is the one the harness
expects, so a later rule never masks an earlier one.

decision_variable.name: target_signature_met
decision_variable.note: Promotion is gated on the transition's own target_signature, not on the SOLO label.

level_ladder._comment: Each transition advances exactly one SOLO level; the bank enforces this.

then.pedagogy: a pedagogy from the remaining pool, held pending

rules.when: target_signature_met == false AND has_available_pedagogy() == false AND case_idx < case_count-1
target_signature_met == false AND has_available_pedagogy() == false AND case_idx == case_count-1

then.attempt_number: responses scored on the current transition so far
then.resets: only when the transition id changes

rules.when: drawing a pedagogy within one case attempt cycle
retrying or reteaching within one case
the client reloads and calls GET /api/next
an intervention fires on a transition

forbidden_outcomes: changing the case on an ordinary retry (no intervention)
repeating a pedagogy within one case attempt cycle
serving a fourth pedagogy instead of recovering
resetting or destroying session history on manual_review
